MONALISHA DAS |Data Analyst|4 + Years |Investment Banking| Bangalore, India | monalishad441@gmail.com +91- 7735875649

PROFILE SUMMARY Results-driven Data Analyst with 4 years of experience in Banking, Credit Risk, Business Intelligence, and Data Analytics. Skilled in SQL, Python, SAS, Alteryx, Power BI, and Excel for data analytics, ETL automation, KPI reporting, dashboarding, portfolio analytics, and MIS reporting. Strong experience in IFRS 9, ECL, PD/LGD/EAD, customer segmentation, root-cause analysis, and stakeholder management, delivering actionable insights for business and risk decisions. Supported Investment Banking analytics initiatives, working with large-scale financial and transactional datasets to deliver data- driven insights for portfolio, risk, and business decision-making. TECHNICAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Databases: SQL Server, SQL • Programming: Python, PySPARK, R, SAS • Analytics & BI Tools: Power BI, Alteryx, AWS, GCP, Excel, Tableau, JIRA, Agile Methdology, Big Query • Data Skills: Data Cleaning, Data Modeling, Data Visualization, Data Storytelling, Data Validation, Dashboard Development, Data Governance, Stakeholder Management, MIS Reporting, Data Quality, Data Transformation • Key Competencies: EDA, ETL, Model Development, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Credit Risk Analytics, Portfolio Monitoring, Risk Segmentation, Roll-Rate Analysis, ECL Monitoring, IFRS 9 Reporting, Basel III, Risk Strategy, PD/LGD/EAD Analysis, KPI Reporting, Regulatory Reporting, EWS, RCA, Vintage Analysis

WORK EXPERIENCE Data Analyst | BNP Paribas SA| 03/2026 – Present

Analyzed secured and unsecured lending portfolios across loan origination, portfolio performance, delinquency



monitoring, and credit risk assessment using SQL, SAS, and Python to support data-driven risk decisions. Extracted, transformed, validated, and analyzed large-scale credit datasets for risk analytics, portfolio management, MIS, and regulatory reporting, ensuring data accuracy and reporting quality.

Performed 30+/60+/90+ DPD, delinquency, NPA, roll-rate, vintage, cohort, and portfolio segmentation analysis to



identify emerging credit risk trends and monitor portfolio health. Supported IFRS 9 ECL reporting by preparing, validating, and reconciling PD, LGD, and EAD datasets, ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.

Developed and optimized SQL queries and daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting workflows, while automating ETL and reporting processes using Alteryx, SAS, SQL, and Python, improving processing efficiency by 30% and reducing manual effort by 40%.

Built Power BI dashboards for NPA, delinquency, roll rates, loan disbursements, and portfolio growth; performed EWS, data reconciliation, root-cause analysis, and ad-hoc analytics in collaboration with Risk, Underwriting, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to support credit policy and portfolio risk management.

Credit Risk Analyst | Bank Of Queensland | 09/2022 – 12/2025



Integrated loan origination, bureau, customer master, behavioral, and macroeconomic datasets covering 500K+ customer records using SQL, Python and SAS, enabling accurate risk parameter extraction for secured and unsecured lending portfolios.

Built and maintained Credit Risk Master datasets (Origination, Performance, Customer, Bureau, and Portfolio Master) using SQL and Alteryx, supporting daily MIS reporting for loan portfolios exceeding $114M+.

Designed scalable ETL pipelines using SQL, Python, and Alteryx to automate data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading into enterprise Data Marts, reducing manual effort by 40% and improving processing speed by 30%. Supported Investment Banking and financial-services analytics initiatives in Queensland, working with large-scale financial and customer datasets to deliver data-driven insights for business and risk decisions.



Performed SQL- and Python-based analysis, data validation and reporting on investment-banking datasets, supporting portfolio analytics, data quality and stakeholder decision-making.

• Developed interactive Power BI dashboards to monitor loan applications, approvals, disbursements, rejections, cancellations, portfolio growth, delinquency, DPD, NPA, and business KPIs, enabling faster executive decision making.

Performed portfolio monitoring, delinquency analysis, DPD (30+/60+/90+), roll-rate analysis, vintage analysis, cohort analysis, and customer segmentation using SQL and Power BI to identify high-risk accounts and emerging portfolio trends. Supported IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) reporting by preparing and validating datasets for PD, LGD, and EAD calculations, ensuring data quality for regulatory and internal risk reporting.



• Analyzed policy exception approvals, bureau scores, underwriting performance, and override trends using SQL,

SAS, and Power BI, strengthening credit governance and improving lending decision quality.

Delivered automated MIS reports, ad hoc analysis, executive dashboards, and stakeholder insights by collaborating with Risk, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and Business teams to support portfolio optimization and strategic decision-making.

Data Analyst | Uber| 12/2025 - 02/2026 EDUCATION M.Tech| BPUT University | 2021 – 2023 LANGUAGES English | Odia | Hindi CERTIFICATIONS

Alteryx Designer Core • Hacker Rank – Advanced SQL

ACHIEVEMENTS



Improved credit risk reporting efficiency by 30% and reduced manual effort by 40% by automating ETL and MIS reporting workflows using SQL, SAS, Python, and Alteryx.

Strengthened portfolio risk monitoring across $114M+ lending portfolios by developing automated Power BI dashboards and performing DPD, NPA, roll-rate, vintage, and delinquency analysis.

Enhanced data quality and regulatory reporting readiness by validating and reconciling PD, LGD, EAD, and IFRS 9 ECL datasets, supporting accurate risk and compliance reporting.

sections.label: Awards and achievements
sections.text:
ACHIEVEMENTS

Improved credit risk reporting efficiency by 30% and reduced manual effort by 40% by automating ETL and MIS reporting workflows using SQL, SAS, Python, and Alteryx.
Strengthened portfolio risk monitoring across $114M+ lending portfolios by developing automated Power BI dashboards and performing DPD, NPA, roll-rate, vintage, and delinquency analysis.
Enhanced data quality and regulatory reporting readiness by validating and reconciling PD, LGD, EAD, and IFRS 9 ECL datasets, supporting accurate risk and compliance reporting.
